text:
ben_customer: Hey team -- our billing ingest suddenly started failing for invoices. The API is returning the `paid` field as "true" (string) sometimes and true (boolean) other times. downstream CSV import throws. example payload: ```{"invoice_id": "12345", "amount": 499, "paid": "true"}``` Can you advise? We haven't changed our client.

alice_support: @ben_customer sorry about that. Can you paste the request/response ids or a full payload with headers? Which model + mode are you using? :ear:

ben_customer: Sure, request id r-0a1b2c, model redwood-open-1, using structured JSON mode with schema enforcement. Header: `X-Mode: strict_json`. Happened after last week deploy. Also saw `customer_id` sometimes quoted: `"9876"` instead of number. Billing ingest expects numeric id.

alice_support: Thanks. Repro steps incoming. I'll try to reproduce with the same model and strict_json flag.

claire_engineer: FYI, I saw a similar report in another tenant yesterday. Might be related to a tokenizer change we rolled for long strings. Logs show outputs getting coerced to strings when the top-level generation path inserts literals. Investigating.

dan_ml: Could be regression in the structured-output parser when the model outputs quoted literals. Quick check: some models emit `\"true\"` tokens sequence. We coerce when `strict_json` is off but should error when strict. Is the API returning a parse error or valid JSON with quoted booleans?

ben_customer: It's valid JSON (parses), but types mismatched vs schema. So it passes our parser but fails ingest downstream because schema expects boolean.

alice_support: Claire, can you attach the service log for r-0a1b2c and the parse result? I'll also open a billing support ticket so ingestion team holds retries.

claire_engineer: Pasted minimal repro I'm running: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxx" \
  -H "X-Mode: strict_json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-1","prompt":"generate invoice json"}'
```
Response snippet: ```{"invoice_id":12345,"paid":"false","customer_id":"9876"}```

eva_sre: Escalating to eng-runtime and scheduler. @claire_engineer @dan_ml please add to incident queue. tagging deploy-bot to see deploys around the time.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood-open-1@2026-03-10T02:12:34Z to prod in region us-west-2

dan_ml: This lines up. I'll run evals to see frequency. Interim workaround for customers: enable `coerce_types: true` in the client shim to cast numeric strings and quoted booleans to expected types, or run a lightweight transform `{ paid: paid === "true" || paid === true }` before ingestion.

alice_support: Ben, sorry again. Workaround options: 1) add client transform, 2) set `X-Mode: strict_schema_fail` to force API to return parse errors instead of coerced values, or 3) we can turn on a tenant-level fixer while eng patches. Which do you prefer? :thinking:

ben_customer: We'll enable a client transform for now and would like tenant fixer while you patch. Also need a billing hold to prevent mischarges. Thanks.

alice_support: Done — I've flagged billing and opened INC-5421, assigned to @billing-team. Claire/Dan, please attach timeline and expected patch ETA.

claire_engineer: Will do. Root cause suspected: model produced quoted primitives; runtime's JSON postprocessor attempted soft coercion in this path. PR coming today to make coercion opt-in and to add stricter schema enforcement when `strict_json` is set.

dan_ml: I'll follow up with evaluation results and a canary rollout plan. Thanks everyone.
